name: security-idempotency-key-tenancy-review
intent: Idempotency key binding to actor, tenant and request meaning
artifacts: Idempotency store keys, response cache, payload fingerprint, operation type and expiry/cleanup.
trace: Determine whether a caller-chosen key can select another actor response or suppress/replace a different operation. Distinguish retries from unrelated requests.
experiment: Use two owned tenants and synthetic reversible operations sharing one key; compare the rightful retry with a changed payload or tenant.
disproof: A duplicate correctly returning the same caller result is expected; shared key syntax does not prove cross-user cache reuse.
repair: Bind cached outcomes to security context and operation meaning, preserving safe retries and documented conflict responses.
branch_decisions: Model first use, rightful retry, changed body, changed tenant and expiry separately. Some APIs intentionally reject a reused key with different parameters. Returning another tenant response, suppressing its action or replaying its effect are different outcomes; do not infer all three from a key collision.
